chunks: As for those who preserve themselves from evil and follow the straight path, there is attainment for them:

key_terms.لِلْمُتَّقِينَ: For the God-conscious / Those who practice Taqwa

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for the Muttaqeen (God-fearing) according to Surah Al-Mursalat?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah An-Naba (77:41) is often interpreted as the culmination of the spiritual journey, where 'Mafaz' signifies not merely survival but the ultimate triumph and proximity to the Divine. It underscores the principle that true success is contingent upon Taqwa, a concept deeply linked in Shi'ism to the guidance of the Ahl al-Bayt and the preservation of faith amidst trials. This promise serves as a profound motivation for believers to align their actions with divine will to secure their eternal felicity.
